title: Paying a LandlordGuard Renewal Term in Full: Terms and Customer Payment Tool
content:
**Terms.** A named insured on the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy who pays the renewal term premium in full pays it in one payment recorded against the upcoming term; that payment settles renewal installment 1, and no installment is billed for a term paid in full.

The renewal term premium is fixed only once the policy record carries the indicated renewal premium for the upcoming term.

In the same terms: while the policy record carries no indicated renewal premium for the upcoming term, the renewal term premium is not yet fixed, and there is no fixed amount for a payment in full.

## Situation of use and capability

`pay_renewal_premium_4100e9a3` pays the whole renewal term premium of one LandlordGuard dwelling policy in a single payment by the named insured. One call records one premium payment from the insured against the upcoming term, lowers the policy's premium balance by the amount paid and issues a payment confirmation number. The payment and its confirmation number are then visible on the policy's premium account.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `pay_renewal_premium_4100e9a3`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | the reference id of the landlord dwelling policy record being paid, as given to the insured by the representative from the dwelling policy lookup | identifier |
| `term_effective_date` | the first day of the upcoming term the payment is for | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD in the policy's local time zone; never empty |
| `amount` | the payment amount in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places when recorded |
| `payment_method` | how the insured pays | one of `eft` (from a bank account by electronic funds transfer), `card` (debit or credit card), `check` (a personal check mailed or handed over), `mortgagee_check` (the mortgage lender pays from escrow by its own check), `none` (no payment method applies, which never fits a payment the insured makes) |

## Return

A one-line receipt: "Payment received: entry <entry_id>, confirmation <payment_reference>, <amount> USD by <payment_method> for the term starting <term_effective_date>, posted <posted_date>." The entry id is the new premium-ledger entry, the confirmation is the number issued for this payment, the amount is shown to 2 decimal places, the method is echoed, and the term start and posted date are YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this line means the payment is recorded.

## Basis Q&A

**Against which term is a payment in full recorded?** The upcoming term, identified by its first day.

**Is an installment billed afterwards for that term?** No; a term paid in full has no installment billed.
